data.question: What is the Pearson correlation between product weight and freight value across all order items?

steps: Join the order_items table with the products table using product_id.
Extract product_weight_g from products and freight_value from order_items.
Calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient between product weight and freight value across all order items.

args.purpose: Compute Pearson correlation between product weight and freight value across all order items
args.sql:
SELECT corr(p.product_weight_g, o.freight_value) AS correlation_weight_freight
FROM order_items o
JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_weight_g IS NOT NULL AND o.freight_value IS NOT NULL
